summary: 6-phase plan to teach agent-system/extensions/core/agents/meta-builder-agent.md global-mode semantics. Phase 1 establishes the $TARGET_ROOT contract in Stage 1 (parse mode_target/target_root, hold as $TARGET_ROOT, add a Path Qualification Convention block; CWD must never be the fallback). Phase 2 splits the conflated SCOPE BOUNDARY into an actor/workflow rule (never implement directly) and a location-correctness rule (.claude/ is a disposable deploy tree; created tasks name agent-system/extensions/core/** targets). Phase 3 qualifies read-only inventory ops (Stage 0, Stage 3B, Stage 3C, analyze-mode matrix) against $TARGET_ROOT. Phase 4 retargets task-creation file_scope/affected_area heuristics from .claude/** to source-store paths. Phase 5 qualifies write/mutate ops: scripts via absolute path (generate-todo.sh/manage-topics.sh self-resolve PROJECT_ROOT from BASH_SOURCE[0], and manage-topics.sh has NO override flag), git via single chained cd, DeliverSummary renderings, and Stage 5 return JSON. Phase 6 statically verifies (source/deploy divergence, no bare script calls, contract consistency, bash -n, scope discipline, no new task-number refs) and documents the manual live procedure honestly -- live cross-repo /meta verification is NOT a success criterion (blocked by the workspace-trust dialog, reported NOT OBSERVED). Chosen strategy: fully-qualified absolute paths as the default; chained cd reserved for git only. Independently re-verified all load-bearing factual anchors against the target file before finalizing.
